🔔 Household Bell — User Guide

💡 What is Household Bell?

Household Bell is a zero-latency, serverless household intercom connecting Bri (Caller) and Danny (Receiver). It delivers instant audio chimes and haptic vibrations across rooms using Server-Sent Events (SSE) and Google Apps Script logging.

🚀 How It Works

  • 👩 Bri (The Caller): Taps the giant gold "Ring Bell" button to chime Danny's phone. Can add an optional quick note (e.g. "Bring water" or "Need help with toddler").
  • 👨 Danny (The Receiver): Receives an instant audible chime, screen flash, and persistent alert showing Bri's message and elapsed time. Taps "ON MY WAY!" to acknowledge.
  • Two-Way Confirmation: Once Danny acknowledges, Bri's screen updates immediately with "Danny is On His Way!" and a running person banner.
  • Serverless Cloud Logging: Every chime and acknowledgement is logged to your personal Google Sheet ledger for historical review.

⚙️ Quick Tips

  • Role Switching: Tap the identity button in the top bar to switch between Bri and Danny.
  • Sound & Audio Lock: On mobile browsers, make sure to tap once on the screen on load to allow browser audio playback.
